rec.name: PDP Product Gallery Slider with Video
rec.status: Built — delivered (code + setup doc); feedback on install instructions in Oct 2025

what.text: A custom PDP media gallery built as a Swiper slider. Product images and videos sit side by side as horizontal slides: 2 per view on desktop (>=1024px) and 1 per view on mobile. Navigation is an arrow on desktop, swipe on mobile, and thin dash/bar pagination below the slides. Videos are embedded in the slider and take the same space as the images. Native product videos get custom play/pause and fullscreen buttons at the bottom right. External (YouTube/Vimeo) videos show a poster with a play button. 3D models are supported. An optional round 'featured video' thumbnail with a play icon sits at the top right of the gallery and opens a fullscreen video popup (driven by the 'Featured video' and 'Featured video thumbnail' product metafields). The popup is hidden if the metafields are empty.

why.text: Showing several product images next to each other, including a video, lets shoppers see the product from more angles and in motion without extra clicks. This reduces uncertainty about fit, fabric and look, which is especially useful for apparel like jackets, and it lowers the return/doubt barrier before add-to-cart. A video thumbnail that stands out in the corner draws attention to rich content that many shoppers would otherwise miss. Pagination bars and arrows signal that there is more to explore and encourage interaction. Layout consistency between image and video slides avoids jarring jumps.

how.text: 1) Duplicate the theme first. 2) Create the snippet 'ed-product-image-with-video.liquid' and paste the provided code (CSS, Liquid loop over product.media, Swiper init, custom video-control JS). 3) In theme.liquid, add the Swiper 11 CSS and JS from the jsDelivr CDN in the head. 4) In main-product.liquid, comment out the existing media HTML and add {%- render 'ed-product-image-with-video', product: product, section: section -%}. 5) Add product videos/images in the product media in Shopify admin; the slide order follows the media order (drag and drop). 6) Optionally, fill the 'Featured video' (file) and 'Featured video thumbnail' (image) product metafields to show the round popup trigger. The build works with any theme because it uses its own code. Autoplay can be disabled via a theme customizer option (per the developer). Note: the code as shown sets native video to autoplay + loop with no native controls, while the acceptance criteria asked for no autoplay, so check this when configuring. The developer's comment says the option exists.

items: Slides per view: 1 on mobile, 2 on desktop (>=1024px)
Slide order: drag and drop of product media in Shopify admin
Video autoplay on/off (theme customizer option, per developer comment; external video uses the section setting 'enable_video_autoplay')
Video looping (section setting for external videos)
Featured video metafield (file): the video for the popup
Featured video thumbnail metafield (image): round thumbnail with play icon at the top right
Pagination style: dash bullets (a scrollbar option is commented out in code)

dependencies.text: Swiper 11 (CSS + JS via CDN, added to theme.liquid), the snippet ed-product-image-with-video.liquid, and an edit of the theme's main-product.liquid (file name varies by theme). Product metafields 'standard.featured_video' and 'standard.featured_video_thumbnail'. Uses theme variables and snippets such as the 'icon' snippet, settings.reveal_product_media, and the external-video / model-media custom elements. Related: the separate 'CRO | PDP | Video Play Button' feature (popup video), which this slider also supports. A separate older product gallery with a different layout exists. Ensure the required setup doc is provided to the customer.
